title: Isometric feature grid: six services
caption: The isometric-feature-grid recipe: up to six labelled isometric tiles on a 3x2 grid under a title, for service overviews and architecture diagrams.
prompt: Make a 7 second 16:9 service overview for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, using the isometric-feature-grid style: the title "Websites, social media, email, ads and automation" over six tiles: Strategy, Websites, Social media, Email, Ads, Automation. Link the wording to claims.json. Logo in the corner (assets/magnifito-logo.svg). Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #d8c6b4, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, green #8acf31 sparingly, Geist from fonts/. English on screen.
